diagram_math_checks.objects_and_maps: At fixed q, horizontal delta_h:K^{p,r,q}->K^{p+1,r,q} and delta_h:K^{p,r+1,q}->K^{p+1,r+1,q}; vertical arrows (-1)^p delta_v:K^{p,r,q}->K^{p,r+1,q} and (-1)^(p+1) delta_v:K^{p+1,r,q}->K^{p+1,r+1,q}.
diagram_math_checks.relations: Right-then-down composite is (-1)^(p+1) delta_v delta_h; down-then-right is (-1)^p delta_h delta_v. They sum to zero because horizontal and vertical cofaces commute. This is expressly an anticommuting square, with no commutativity assertion.
diagram_math_checks.local_justification: Given paragraph line 36 supplies coface domains and commuting directions; Statement line 32 supplies the signed total differential. Internal component (-1)^(p+r)d and its q+1 target are stated beside the square.

diagram_math_checks.objects_and_maps: T^m is the direct sum over p+r+q=m; A^m is the direct sum over n+q=m of K^{n,n,q}. Alpha:T^bullet->A^bullet and beta:A^bullet->T^bullet are the reversed universal comparisons, preserving total degree.
diagram_math_checks.relations: beta alpha is cochain-homotopic to identity on T; alpha beta is cochain-homotopic to identity on A. Neither strict inverse equality nor termwise K-map is asserted. A has differential delta_diag+(-1)^n d.
diagram_math_checks.local_justification: Proof steps 2.1 and 3.1 construct the auxiliary chain comparisons; 4.1 proves homotopy inverses; 5.1 reverses their variance and includes the internal differential; 6.1 proves augmentation preservation. Statement lines 30-32 specifies the two degree conventions. Explicit explanation distinguishes n+q from 2n+q.
